title: Severely Non-Compliant Entrance Ramps and Stairs
detectedBarriers: Excessively steep ramps (likely far exceeding 1:12 slope)
Lack of handrails on both sides of the ramps
Curved ramps, making maneuvering difficult and dangerous
Insufficient ramp width, especially on curved sections
Lack of level landings at the top and bottom of ramps
Lack of tactile warning surfaces at the top and bottom of stairs and ramps
Poor color contrast on stair treads, making step edges hard to distinguish
Stair handrail does not extend horizontally beyond the top and bottom steps
Potentially slippery ramp surface (tiled)
recommendations: Remove and completely redesign the ramps to meet accessibility standards, ensuring a maximum slope of 1:12, minimum width of 36 inches, level landings at top and bottom, and continuous handrails on both sides extending beyond the ramp.
Install tactile warning strips at the top and bottom of all stairs and any compliant ramps.
Improve color contrast on stair treads to clearly delineate each step.
Ensure stair handrails extend horizontally at least 12 inches beyond the top and bottom risers.
Consider alternative accessible entry solutions such as a platform lift if space for a compliant ramp is insufficient.
Ensure all walking surfaces, especially ramps, are made of slip-resistant materials.
summary: The entrance features stairs and what appear to be an attempt at accessible ramps. However, the 'ramps' are extremely steep, curved, lack handrails, and do not have proper landings, rendering them unusable and highly dangerous for wheelchair users. The stairs also present significant risks for people with visual impairments due to a lack of tactile warnings, poor color contrast, and inadequate handrail extensions. This entrance is severely non-compliant with accessibility standards and poses a high risk to users.
officialReport: This entrance requires immediate remediation to comply with local and national accessibility standards (e.g., ADA, local building codes). A detailed architectural assessment is recommended to design and implement a safe and accessible entry solution.
recommendedInstitution: Local building authority, accessibility consultants, disability advocacy organizations

title: Severely Damaged Road with Numerous Potholes
detectedBarriers: Numerous large and deep potholes across the entire road surface
Extremely uneven and cracked road surface, indicating severe disrepair
Potholes filled with water, creating hidden depths and slippery conditions
Lack of a designated, smooth, and safe pedestrian pathway or sidewalk
recommendations: Undertake immediate and comprehensive road repair to fill all potholes and resurface the damaged sections.
Implement a regular road maintenance schedule to prevent future deterioration and ensure road safety.
Consider constructing a separate, smooth, and accessible pedestrian pathway or sidewalk alongside the road, especially if pedestrian traffic is anticipated.
Ensure proper drainage systems are in place to prevent water accumulation in road depressions.
summary: The road depicted is in a state of severe disrepair, characterized by numerous large and deep potholes, many filled with water, and an extensively cracked surface. This condition renders the road highly inaccessible and dangerous for both wheelchair users and individuals with visual impairments, posing significant risks of falls, injuries, and equipment damage.
officialReport: This report identifies a critical accessibility barrier in the form of a severely damaged road. The presence of numerous large, deep, and water-filled potholes, coupled with an extensively cracked and uneven surface, creates an impassable and hazardous environment. This condition violates fundamental principles of universal design and poses extreme risks to the safety and mobility of individuals using wheelchairs and those with visual impairments. Immediate intervention for repair and maintenance is imperative to ensure basic accessibility and safety.
recommendedInstitution: Local Department of Public Works or Road Maintenance Authority

title: Severe Road Damage and Numerous Potholes
recommendedInstitution: Komuna e Prishtinës - Drejtoria e Shërbimeve Publike
summary: The road in Prishtina is in extremely poor condition, characterized by numerous large and deep potholes, many of which are filled with water. This poses a significant hazard to vehicles and drivers.
officialComplaint: I am writing to report severe damage to a road within the municipality of Prishtina. As evidenced by the accompanying image, the road surface is extensively deteriorated with numerous large and deep potholes, many containing standing water. This condition presents a significant safety risk to all road users and can cause considerable damage to vehicles. I respectfully request that the Directorate of Public Services conduct an immediate inspection of this road and initiate the necessary repair works to restore it to a safe and functional state.

title: Catastrophic Ground Collapse Near Construction Site
detectedBarriers: Massive ground collapse/sinkhole rendering the area impassable
Extreme fall hazard due to large, deep chasm
Uneven, unstable, and broken terrain at the edge of the collapse
Exposed pipes and debris within and around the collapsed area
Lack of adequate safety barriers or fencing to prevent access to the dangerous edge
No accessible alternative routes visible
Absence of tactile warnings for people with visual impairments indicating the severe drop-off
recommendations: Immediately establish robust, high-visibility safety barriers and fencing around the entire perimeter of the collapse to prevent any access.
Install clear, prominent warning signs (visual and potentially audible) indicating extreme danger and no entry.
Implement tactile warning surfaces or barriers at a safe distance from the edge for individuals with visual impairments.
Completely close the affected road and pedestrian areas to all traffic until comprehensive repairs are completed and the area is deemed safe.
Conduct an urgent geological and structural assessment to determine the cause of the collapse and prevent further instability.
Develop and clearly mark accessible alternative routes for pedestrians and vehicles.
Ensure all future construction in the vicinity adheres to strict safety and ground stability protocols.
summary: The image depicts a catastrophic ground collapse, creating a massive, deep chasm that has destroyed a section of the road and surrounding terrain. This area is completely inaccessible and presents an extreme, life-threatening hazard for all individuals, particularly wheelchair users and people with visual impairments. There are no visible safety barriers or warnings to prevent accidental falls into the sinkhole. The risk of severe injury or fatality is exceptionally high.
officialReport: An official report should be initiated by the local municipal engineering department, public works, or emergency services to document the incident, assess the structural integrity of the surrounding infrastructure, and plan for immediate remediation and long-term repairs. The report should also investigate the cause of the collapse, especially in relation to the adjacent construction activities.
recommendedInstitution: Local Municipality, Public Works Department, Emergency Services, Construction Company (Klub Invest, if responsible for adjacent development)

summary: Report of significant waste accumulation in Prishtina.
